methodology: Ten distinct ASA base candidates. Display order groups practical single-player/PvE choices; it is an editorial order, not a vote, raid guarantee or measured resource score. Coordinates retain creator precision. Layout advice is Codex planning inference; source evidence is identified per spot.
limits: All ten GPS pairs and timestamps are in primary ASA creator chapter metadata. Ten genuine 320×180 stills from exact ASA creator chapters are bundled; they were visually reviewed for terrain, not readable GPS. Chapter names support terrain and suggested use, not current spawn safety, foundation footprint or server build permission. The wiki warns ASA single-M minimap coordinates can differ from waypoints/double-M map coordinates.

locations.name: Herbivore Island · South Haven
locations.why: An offshore base candidate for controlled creature space and a separate supply dock.
pros: Wiki describes the region as having no aggressive terrestrial carnivore spawns.
The primary ASA guide supplies this approach GPS.
cons: Ocean transit and hostile sea creatures remain risks.
Do not substitute older wiki region-centre coordinates for this ASA creator pin.
layout: Keep the workshop beside the dock for arriving materials.
Fence measured breeding space and preserve the hill resource spawns.
